name: Pace Setter
description: Fast two-line note setting how long the next reply runs and what it ends on, based on {{user}}'s last message. Don't run it with: Length Trimmer, Scene Pressure Cocktail, Combined Director's Cut.
author: Purachina
prompt:
{{// Fast pre-generation note. Two lines, inserted just before the main model writes.}}{{trim}}
Read {{user}}'s latest message and the current scene. Decide how the next reply should move, and write exactly two lines:
Length: short (1-2 paragraphs), medium (3-4) or long (5 or more). Match {{user}}'s message: quick back-and-forth dialogue gets a short reply; a big action or a new scene can run long.
End on: dialogue or action, whichever gives {{user}} the clearest thing to respond to, plus a few words on what it is.

Write only the two lines.
